chunks: Indeed, some poetry contains wisdom, and indeed, some speech has a magical effect.

key_terms.الشِّعْرِ: poetry; composed verse that may convey meaningful insight
key_terms.الْبَيَانِ: eloquent speech; clear and expressive articulation
key_terms.حِكْمَةً: wisdom; sound truth and beneficial insight
key_terms.لَسِحْرًا: like magic in effect; having a powerful and captivating influence

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about poetry and eloquent speech?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that eloquent expression can carry profound wisdom and deep influence. It recognizes that both poetry and powerful speech can shape hearts and minds in remarkable ways.
